posts.name: FirstResume
posts.tagline: Turn what you've done into a resume that gets interviews
posts.description: Resume builders are built for professionals — and charge monthly for the privilege. Students stare at a blank template with nothing to put in it. FirstResume flips it. Describe what you've done in plain words — jobs, projects, volunteering, hobbies. AI turns it into polished, professional resume content that gets past screening. Free to start; $5 once for the full polish and downloads. No subscription, no account, no upsells. Built for students writing their first resume.

posts.name: detect & fix breaking API changes
posts.tagline: Detect API changes before they break your code.
posts.description: Breaklytix helps engineering teams detect API changes before they become production incidents. Connect your GitHub repository, discover your API dependencies, monitor provider changes and deprecations, and see exactly which repositories, files, and code usage could be affected. Get actionable risk insights and recommended next steps—so your team can fix API issues before they break your code.

posts.name: Wanna Try
posts.tagline: Save any reel. We remind you when you can go.
posts.description: Bookmarks pile up; Wanna Try turns them into plans. Share a reel, post, link, screenshot or voice note and it reads it, Hindi included, pulling out the place, price and key points. Nudges bring saves back when you can act: weekends, good weather, nearby. Ask your saves anything ("plan my Saturday") and confirm one tap actions: mark tried, plan a day, remind me. Speak a trip plan and it sets the reminder for you. Free, built in India.
